title: Atlas 2 private label
description: Never shown to a reviewer. Joined to the blind item by item_id. Items in the private split also carry a canary string so accidental publication is detectable.

class.description: established_non_transferring is the fourth class: a real dictionary from the literature that supplies no crossing result. Conflating it with gold is the error pre-registration exists to prevent.

kind.description: The relation type. 'none' is correct for decoys and for vacuous items.

crossing_result.description: The specific theorem or bound that crosses from one side to the other, or null. Required for gold; if null, the item is established_non_transferring, not gold.

expected_axis2.description: Optional author's expectation for Axis 2. Not a ground truth for AUROC; used only to check calibration.

source_record_id.description: The atlas record id this item derives from, for atlas and shuffled classes only.

shuffle_variant.description: Which negative generator produced this item.

canary.description: Present only in the private split; its appearance in public output is a leak.
